summary: Comprehensive backend testing (18/18 pytest tests passed) covering all endpoints: settings CRUD & validation, stock CRUD, allocations bulk update, dashboard math (daily_budget = monthly*pct/100/days, accrued = daily*days_elapsed, remaining = accrued-spent), entries (floor units calc, price validation, insufficient budget rejection, newest-first sort, filter by stock, delete), rollover reflected in dashboard, and independent resets (budget-only, allocations-only, logs-only). Verified _id never returned. Frontend smoke test confirms Expo web preview loads on mobile viewport, dashboard renders with hero card + empty state + 'Go to Settings' CTA, navigates to Settings tab, add-stock bottom sheet opens and inputs accept values.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal 'Add Stock' submit button rendered outside viewport in web preview at 390x844; scrollIntoView didn't help. On native this is fine due to KeyboardAvoidingView, but web preview clips it. Consider adding a ScrollView inside the sheet or reducing padding.

action_items: Optional: ensure Add-Stock bottom sheet content is scrollable or shorter so submit button stays in viewport on smaller web previews (native app unaffected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes _id in all reads via projection {'_id':0} — good.
business_days_elapsed correctly counts Mon-Fri from month start; capped by trading_days in dashboard & entry creation.
Entry creation recomputes accrued-spent server-side so client cannot buy beyond remaining. Good.
PUT /settings validates negative budget and non-positive trading_days.
PUT /allocations silently skips items missing id/pct — acceptable for MVP but could warn.
seed_data_creation: Tests self-seed and clean up 3 stocks (RELI/TCS/INFY). Final state: RELI + TCS remain (INFY deleted in last test), entries cleared, settings reset to defaults 30000/22.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend deep UI flow testing (buy modal calc, history filter chips scrolling, danger-zone reset confirms) not fully exercised due to time; main agent can visually verify or request extended UI run.
